name: Marcell Szakály
biography: Marcell Szakály is a PhD student in the Systems Security Lab at the University of Oxford. His research focuses on the security of the EV charging infrastructure. He received his masters degree in Physics, and worked on superconducting magnet design. His work now involves RF hardware, SDRs, and digital electronics.
